title: Playwright Project Blueprint
description: Canonical blueprint describing an entire generated Playwright test project. Produced by the Code Generation Agent and consumed by the Playwright Execution Agent. This contract defines the complete project structure — folder layout, configuration, test files, page objects, fixtures, utilities, reporters, browser matrix, dependencies, environment, and artifacts. It contains NO source code, only project metadata and structure descriptions.

runId.description: Globally unique identifier for the test execution run. Must match the runId across all pipeline contracts.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier from the originating HTTP request. Must match the requestId across all pipeline contracts.

projectMetadata.description: Top-level metadata describing the generated Playwright project — its identity, framework versions, repository name, and output directory.

projectStructure.description: Describes the complete directory and file structure of the generated project. Every file that should exist is declared here with its path, category, and purpose.

configuration.description: The Playwright configuration for the generated project — timeouts, workers, parallelism, retries, browser profiles, viewport, locale, and output directories.

browserMatrix.description: Browser and device matrix defining which browsers, viewports, and devices the project is configured to test against.

testFiles.description: Specifications for every generated test file. Each test file declares which source test cases it implements, which page objects and fixtures it imports, and which execution group it belongs to.

pageObjects.description: Specifications for generated page object models. Each page object encapsulates the interaction model for one or more application pages.

fixtures.description: Specifications for generated test fixtures — authentication fixtures, data fixtures, API fixtures, browser fixtures, environment fixtures, and cleanup fixtures.

utilities.description: Specifications for generated utility and helper modules — date helpers, random data generators, API helpers, authentication helpers, assertion helpers, and database helpers.

reporters.description: Reporter configuration for the generated project — which reporters are enabled and their output settings.

executionGroups.description: Execution groups defining which test files, browser profiles, and configuration overrides apply to different test runs — smoke, regression, nightly, critical, security, accessibility, performance.

dependencies.description: NPM dependencies required by the generated project — Playwright version, plugins, utilities, and external libraries.

environment.description: Environment configuration for the generated project — environment variables, secrets references, configuration files, and runtime requirements.

artifacts.description: Artifact output configuration — screenshots, videos, trace files, downloads, logs, and coverage reports.

generationMetadata.description: Metadata about the code generation process — when it ran, which source contracts were consumed, the generator version, overall confidence, and warnings.
